# Quadraverse — Quadraverb patch editor / translator
# Reuses plugin_host_app sources for audio/MIDI/hardware/AU hosting.

set(HOST_SRC "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../plugin_host_app/Source")
set(RENDERER_SRC "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../plugin_renderer/Source")

# Reuse version headers generated by plugin_host_app.
set(AUFX_GEN_DIR "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/plugin_host_app/generated")
if(NOT DEFINED AUFX_SEMVER)
    set(AUFX_SEMVER "0.1.0")
endif()

juce_add_gui_app(Quadraverse
    PRODUCT_NAME "Quadraverse"
    VERSION "${AUFX_SEMVER}"
    BUNDLE_ID "com.aufxtest.Quadraverse"
    COMPANY_NAME "Mike Jennings"
    COMPANY_COPYRIGHT "Copyright (c) Mike Jennings"
    ICON_BIG "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/Resources/app_icon.png"
    PLUGINHOST_AU TRUE
    PLUGINHOST_VST3 TRUE
    MICROPHONE_PERMISSION_ENABLED TRUE
    MICROPHONE_PERMISSION_TEXT "Quadraverse needs microphone access when monitoring audio hardware.")

set_target_properties(Quadraverse PROPERTIES
    MACOSX_BUNDLE_GUI_IDENTIFIER "com.aufxtest.Quadraverse"
    MACOSX_BUNDLE_BUNDLE_NAME "Quadraverse"
    XCODE_ATTRIBUTE_PRODUCT_BUNDLE_IDENTIFIER "com.aufxtest.Quadraverse"
    XCODE_ATTRIBUTE_INFOPLIST_KEY_LSApplicationCategoryType "public.app-category.music"
    XCODE_ATTRIBUTE_INFOPLIST_KEY_NSHighResolutionCapable YES)

target_include_directories(Quadraverse
    PRIVATE
        Source
        ${HOST_SRC}
        ${RENDERER_SRC}
        ${AUFX_GEN_DIR})

target_sources(Quadraverse
    PRIVATE
        Source/Main.cpp
        Source/MainWindow.cpp
        Source/MainContent.cpp
        Source/domain/AlesisCodec.cpp
        Source/domain/QuadraverbProgram.cpp
        Source/domain/DeviceProfile.cpp
        Source/domain/PatchTranslator.cpp
        Source/domain/PatchContextManager.cpp
        Source/formats/SyxIO.cpp
        Source/formats/SsxImporter.cpp
        Source/formats/Qdv1StateIO.cpp
        Source/ui/PatchEditorPanel.cpp
        Source/ui/PluginHostPanel.cpp
        Source/ui/PluginHostWindow.cpp
        Source/ui/CompatibilityReviewDialog.cpp
        Source/ui/SaveToDiskDialog.cpp
        Source/project/ProjectFile.cpp
        Source/report/ComparisonReportDialog.cpp
        # Shared host sources
        ${HOST_SRC}/HostConfig.cpp
        ${HOST_SRC}/HostPreferences.cpp
        ${HOST_SRC}/HostLog.cpp
        ${HOST_SRC}/HostLookAndFeel.cpp
        ${HOST_SRC}/PluginAudioEngine.cpp
        ${HOST_SRC}/MonitorOutputBridge.cpp
        ${HOST_SRC}/HardwareLoopOps.cpp
        ${HOST_SRC}/MidiHostServices.cpp
        ${HOST_SRC}/HostClockMetronome.cpp
        ${HOST_SRC}/OfflineCapture.cpp
        ${HOST_SRC}/CapturePipeline.cpp
        ${HOST_SRC}/SessionSnap.cpp
        ${HOST_SRC}/LevelMetersWindow.cpp
        ${HOST_SRC}/LevelMetrics.cpp
        ${HOST_SRC}/LevelSweepCalibration.cpp
        ${HOST_SRC}/NoiseFloorCalibration.cpp
        ${HOST_SRC}/SettingsDialog.cpp
        ${HOST_SRC}/HardwareAudioSetupDialog.cpp
        ${HOST_SRC}/MidiSetupDialog.cpp
        ${HOST_SRC}/MidiEndpointInfo.cpp
        ${HOST_SRC}/sysex/SysexDeviceRegistry.cpp
        ${HOST_SRC}/sysex/QuadraverbSysex.cpp
        ${HOST_SRC}/PresetHardwareState.cpp
        ${HOST_SRC}/SourceClipLibrary.cpp
        ${HOST_SRC}/PluginScanLog.cpp
        ${HOST_SRC}/AuPluginScanner.cpp
        ${HOST_SRC}/AuPluginScanDialog.cpp
        ${HOST_SRC}/PluginScannerOOP.cpp
        ${HOST_SRC}/HostChromeControls.cpp
        ${RENDERER_SRC}/AUpresetLoader.cpp
        ${AUFX_GEN_DIR}/AppVersion.cpp)

set_source_files_properties("${AUFX_GEN_DIR}/AppVersion.cpp" "${AUFX_GEN_DIR}/AppVersion.h"
    PROPERTIES GENERATED TRUE)

if(TARGET plugin_host_app_version)
    add_dependencies(Quadraverse plugin_host_app_version)
endif()

target_sources(Quadraverse PRIVATE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/Resources/host.config.json")
set_source_files_properties("${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/Resources/host.config.json"
    PROPERTIES MACOSX_PACKAGE_LOCATION "Resources")

set(AUFX_FIXTURES_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../fixtures")
add_custom_command(TARGET Quadraverse POST_BUILD
    COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E rm -rf
        "$<TARGET_BUNDLE_DIR:Quadraverse>/Contents/Resources/fixtures"
    COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_directory
        "${AUFX_FIXTURES_DIR}"
        "$<TARGET_BUNDLE_DIR:Quadraverse>/Contents/Resources/fixtures"
    COMMENT "Syncing fixtures into Quadraverse bundle"
    VERBATIM)

target_compile_definitions(Quadraverse
    PRIVATE
        JUCE_WEB_BROWSER=0
        JUCE_USE_CURL=0
        JUCE_VST3_CAN_REPLACE_VST2=0
        JUCE_MODAL_LOOPS_PERMITTED=1
        HOST_APP_NAME="Quadraverse"
        HOST_BUNDLE_ID="com.aufxtest.Quadraverse")

target_link_libraries(Quadraverse
    PRIVATE
        juce::juce_audio_utils
        juce::juce_audio_processors
        juce::juce_audio_formats
        juce::juce_dsp
        juce::juce_gui_extra
        juce::juce_data_structures
    PUBLIC
        juce::juce_recommended_config_flags
        juce::juce_recommended_warning_flags)

if(APPLE)
    target_sources(Quadraverse PRIVATE
        ${HOST_SRC}/AUpresetSaver_mac.mm
        ${HOST_SRC}/HostPreferences_mac.mm
        ${HOST_SRC}/MidiEndpointInfo_mac.mm
        ${HOST_SRC}/PluginScannerWorker_mac.mm
        ${HOST_SRC}/LightsOutManager.mm
        ${RENDERER_SRC}/AUpresetLoader_mac.mm)
    set_source_files_properties(
        ${HOST_SRC}/MidiEndpointInfo_mac.mm
        ${HOST_SRC}/LightsOutManager.mm
        PROPERTIES COMPILE_FLAGS "-fobjc-arc")
    target_link_libraries(Quadraverse PRIVATE
        "-framework AppKit"
        "-framework Foundation"
        "-framework CoreFoundation"
        "-framework CoreMIDI")
else()
    target_sources(Quadraverse PRIVATE ${HOST_SRC}/AUpresetSaver.cpp)
    target_compile_definitions(Quadraverse PRIVATE
        JUCE_PLUGIN_HOST_NO_MAC_PRESET=1
        JUCE_PLUGIN_RENDERER_NO_MAC_PRESET=1)
endif()

juce_generate_juce_header(Quadraverse)

juce_add_console_app(quadraverse_tests PRODUCT_NAME "quadraverse_tests")
target_sources(quadraverse_tests PRIVATE
    Tests/CodecTests.cpp
    Source/domain/AlesisCodec.cpp
    Source/domain/QuadraverbProgram.cpp
    Source/domain/DeviceProfile.cpp
    Source/formats/SyxIO.cpp
    Source/formats/SsxImporter.cpp)
target_include_directories(quadraverse_tests PRIVATE Source ${HOST_SRC})
target_compile_definitions(quadraverse_tests PRIVATE
    JUCE_WEB_BROWSER=0
    JUCE_USE_CURL=0
    QUADRAVERSE_FIXTURES_DIR="${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../fixtures/ssx")
target_link_libraries(quadraverse_tests PRIVATE
    juce::juce_core
    juce::juce_events
    juce::juce_data_structures
    juce::juce_audio_basics
    juce::juce_recommended_config_flags)
juce_generate_juce_header(quadraverse_tests)
enable_testing()
add_test(NAME quadraverse_codec COMMAND $<TARGET_FILE:quadraverse_tests>)

# Register at the top-level build too.
set_property(GLOBAL APPEND PROPERTY CTEST_TARGETS_ADDED 1)
